overview.description: The Vanguard FTSE All-World ex-US Small-Cap ETF (VSS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund tracks a market-cap-weighted index of global non-US small-cap stocks. VSS was launched on Apr 2, 2009 and is issued by Vanguard.
